title: Objectwise cochain resolution and augmentation
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $C$ be a preadditive category with a zero object, and let $\iota:C\to A$ be fully faithful. Let $\Lambda=(F,\pi)$ be a left-resolution datum [lem-sfb-left-resolution-reduced-api] for $\iota$ (a functor $F:A\to C$ and a natural transformation $\pi:\iota F\Rightarrow\operatorname{id}_A$ with epimorphic components) whose functor $F$ preserves zero morphisms. Its cochain-complex resolution functor $R:A\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(C,\mathbb Z)$ is defined by iterating $\Lambda$ on kernels: $R(X)^q=0$ for $q>0$, $R(X)^0=F(X)$, $R(X)^{-1}=F(\ker\pi_X)$ with $d^{-1}$ the unique map satisfying $\iota(d^{-1})=\pi_{\ker\pi_X}$ followed by the inclusion $\ker\pi_X\to\iota F(X)$, and for $n\ge1$, $R(X)^{-n-1}=F(\ker\iota(d^{-n}))$ with $\iota(d^{-n-1})=\pi_{\ker\iota(d^{-n})}$ followed by the kernel inclusion; on morphisms $R$ acts through $F$ and the induced kernel maps. The augmentation is the cochain map $\iota R(X)\to X[0]$ (the complex with $X$ in degree $0$ and zero elsewhere) given by $\pi_X$ in degree $0$; it is natural in $X$. Every component of this map is a quasi-isomorphism, and every complex $R(X)$ is strictly supported in degrees $\le 0$; the same support assertion holds after applying $\iota$ termwise.
